subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR remain the canonical landing candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877, and should the optional `currentAttemptReplayMetadata` result field plus server-error retry-before-failover behavior be accepted?
rationale: Several open and closed sibling PRs target the same bug, the current branch is dirty, and the remaining decision is maintainer acceptance of compatibility/proof rather than a narrow code defect ClawSweeper can safely repair here.

options.title: Refresh and keep this candidate
options.body: Ask the contributor or a maintainer to refresh the branch, add or accept full-runner/gateway proof, and then proceed with this current-attempt metadata shape.

options.title: Use a sibling as canonical
options.body: Move review focus to a sibling PR only after it has no blocking findings and remains a viable merge target with positive proof.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want the optional attempt-result field or the server-error retry ordering in the embedded runner contract.

recommendation.title: Refresh and keep this candidate
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor or a maintainer to refresh the branch, add or accept full-runner/gateway proof, and then proceed with this current-attempt metadata shape.
